en.headline: PolyU programme to train 17,000 seniors on safer falls
en.dek: A 45-month Jockey Club-funded project launched on Wednesday will combine bone-density checks, an AI risk score and judo-based landing drills for people aged 60 or above.
body: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University on Wednesday launched a 45-month community programme that aims to reach about 17,000 people aged 60 or above with training on how to land more safely if they fall.

The Jockey Club SafeMove Fall Management Programme, funded by The Hong Kong Jockey Club Charities Trust, is being run with five welfare groups: Haven of Hope Christian Service, Hong Kong Sheng Kung Hui Welfare Council, Jockey Club Cadenza Hub, the Hong Kong Society for Rehabilitation and Yan Chai Hospital. Under Secretary for Labour and Welfare Ho Kai-ming attended the launch on campus.

Participants will first have a bone-density test and an artificial-intelligence fall-risk assessment developed by PolyU's Department of Rehabilitation Sciences. Those assessed as suitable will join a 12-week course designed with professional judo coaches, twice a week for an hour, moving from seated rolls to kneeling and standing landings. Physiotherapy advice will be offered where needed.

Chair Professor Marco Pang, head of the department, said official figures show about 16 per cent of older people in Hong Kong fall at least once a year, and about one in ten of those falls leads to a fracture, most often of the hip. Associate Head Amy Fu said teaching people how to react quickly when they lose balance could cut the chance of a fracture. The university said community-dwelling residents aged 60 or above may apply through the partner groups.

zh.headline: 理大推防跌計劃 料惠及1.7萬名長者
zh.dek: 賽馬會資助的45個月計劃周三啟動，結合骨質密度檢測、人工智能跌倒評估及柔道安全着地訓練，對象為60歲或以上社區長者。
body: 香港理工大學周三推出為期45個月的社區計劃，預計惠及約1.7萬名60歲或以上長者，教授跌倒時較安全的着地及自我保護方法。
「賽馬會『柔韌有餘』防跌管理計劃」由香港賽馬會慈善信託基金捐助，聯同基督教靈實協會、香港聖公會福利協會、賽馬會流金匯、香港復康會及仁濟醫院推行。勞工及福利局副局長何啟明出席在理大校園舉行的啟動禮。
參加者會先接受骨質密度檢測，以及理大康復治療科學系研發的人工智能跌倒風險評估。合適人士將參與由研究團隊與專業柔道教練共同設計、為期12星期的課程，每周兩節、每節一小時，由坐地滾動逐步練習跽地及站立着地。有需要者可獲物理治療諮詢。
康復治療科學系主任彭耀宗講座教授引述數字指，本港每年約16%長者至少跌倒一次，當中約一成導致骨折，以髒骨骨折較常見。副系主任傅亞麗表示，教導長者在失去平衡時迅速作出保護，有助減低骨折機會。理大表示，居於社區、年滿60歲的人士可經合作機構參加。
